chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

The time of Salat al-Jumu'ah on Friday is at the hour when the sun declines. Its time is the same in travel and residence, and it is among the restricted times. And the Asr prayer on Friday is in the first time as on the rest of the days.

key_terms.الْحَضَرِ: the state of residence or being settled
key_terms.الْمُضَيَّقِ: a restricted or narrowly-defined time window
key_terms.سَاعَةَ تَزُولُ: the moment when the sun begins to decline from midday
key_terms.وَقْتُ: the legally designated time for performing an act of worship

ai.seo_question: When does Salat al-Jumu'ah begin on Friday, and is its time different for travelers and residents?
ai.summary: This hadith states the prescribed time of Salat al-Jumu'ah as beginning at zawal, when the sun declines from its zenith. It also establishes that this timing does not differ between traveler and resident, and it links the Friday Asr prayer to the earlier prayer-time framework mentioned for the other daily prayers.
